describes: A closed class of English function words (determiners, coordinators, negators, pronouns, copula/auxiliary forms, prepositions) that can never be a legitimate action_head verb lemma. deontic.prose_grammar._action_head consults this stoplist as a defensive backstop after computing a candidate lemma (from verb_lemma.json's lemma_exceptions or the stdlib suffix fallback): a candidate landing in this closed class abstains (field_reasons['action_head'] = ACTION_HEAD_INDETERMINATE) instead of publishing a function word as if it were a governing verb — independent of, and in addition to, the grammar productions (the negation?/subject_leads productions in particular) that are meant to keep such a word from ever opening the action span in the first place. Membership only, matched against the already-lower-cased candidate lemma; not a pattern.
